sims_w15._about: Values Part 15 (author w15, 2026-10-09) cites: protocol header sizes from the RFCs already in docs/sources.md, and defaults from pages the author opened (SRC-640 to SRC-653).

http2_frame_header_bytes.note: RFC 9113 sec 4.1: 'All frames begin with a fixed 9-octet header'.

tls_record_header_bytes.note: RFC 9846 sec 5.2 TLSCiphertext: opaque_type (1) + legacy_record_version (2) + length (2).

tls_inner_content_type_bytes.note: RFC 9846 sec 5.2 TLSInnerPlaintext: one ContentType byte after the content (no padding).

aead_tag_bytes.note: RFC 9001 sec 5.3: the TLS 1.3 cipher suites used by QUIC 'have a 16-byte authentication tag'; the same AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305 tag applies to TLS records.

quic_short_header_flags_bytes.note: RFC 9000 sec 17.3.1, 1-RTT packet: first byte holds header form, fixed bit, spin, reserved, key phase, packet number length.

quic_stream_frame_type_bytes.note: RFC 9000 sec 19.8: STREAM frame type 0x08..0x0f (one-byte varint).

http3_data_frame_type_bytes.note: RFC 9114 sec 7.2.1: DATA frame Type (i) = 0x00, then Length (i).

grpc_message_prefix_bytes.note: gRPC over HTTP/2: Compressed-Flag (1 byte) + Message-Length (4 bytes, big endian).

udp_header_bytes.note: RFC 768: the minimum value of the length field is eight (header only).

ipv4_min_header_bytes.note: RFC 791: IHL minimum value 5 (32-bit words) = 20 bytes.

tcp_min_header_bytes.note: RFC 9293 sec 3.1: Data Offset minimum 5 (32-bit words) = 20 bytes; options add more.

tcp_delayed_ack_max_s.note: RFC 9293 sec 3.8.6.3: the ACK delay 'MUST be less than 0.5 seconds (MUST-40)'.

envoy_listener_buffer_limit_bytes.note: Envoy Listener.per_connection_buffer_limit_bytes: 'If unspecified, an implementation defined default is applied (1MiB).'

envoy_route_timeout_s.note: Envoy timeouts FAQ: route timeout 'defaults to 15 seconds'; 'typically a problem for streaming responses'.

envoy_stream_idle_timeout_s.note: Envoy timeouts FAQ: 'The default stream idle timeout is 5 minutes.'

linux_tcp_wmem_default_bytes.note: tcp(7) tcp_wmem default: 'The default value is 16 kB' (16,384 bytes); max is max(65536, min(4 MB, tcp_mem[1]*PAGE_SIZE/128)).

cloudflare_proxy_read_timeout_s.note: Cloudflare error 524 page: 'the origin did not provide an HTTP response before the default 125 seconds'.
